title: Data Preprocessing Pipelie for CAN-IMPACT
text: R package organizes raw CAN-IMPACT REDCap exports analysis-ready data tables performs basic data quality control. package: Splits raw REDCap export separate data tables. Calculates participant ages parses ETI start dates. Converts raw spirometry measurements percent predicted. Performs data quality checks missing implausible values. Produces QC log describing values flagged modified.
